decision.explanation: The question asks what 'Gerstnerova' is named after. The provided sources contain two distinct, conflicting assertions regarding the origin of the name. Source D1 explicitly states the street was named in 2012 in honor of the album 'Fallen Empires' by Snow Patrol. Source D2 explicitly states the street was named in 1885 in honor of Franz Josef Gerstner. Per the instruction to preserve distinct valid referents and not collapse multi-answer questions to a single winner when competing assertions exist, both answers are retained as they represent separate claimed origins found in the source text.
